rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for unspecified oil, including liquid fat, fuel or lubricant, and petroleum in a general context.

example.jyutping: gaa3 daan1 ce1 tiu4 lin6 jiu3 caa4 jau4

rows.note: Use 菜油 for edible vegetable or cooking oil, not for liquid fat generally.

example.english: Cooking with vegetable oil makes it more fragrant.
example.jyutping: zyu2 coi3 jung6 coi3 jau4 wui5 hoeng1 di1

rows.note: Use 石油 when you mean petroleum or crude oil explicitly rather than oil in general.

example.english: This country mainly relies on exporting oil.
example.traditional: 呢個國家主要靠出口石油。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 zyu2 jiu3 kaau3 ceot1 hau2 sek6 jau4
